svg.title: Step 1: did they really ask for deletion?
svg.desc: Four people write in. "Please erase my account and all my data" and a German request to delete an account are deletion requests, so they get audited. "Can you send me a copy of my data?" and "Stop sending me marketing emails" are not deletion requests, so they are marked not applicable and nothing else runs. An AI model reads each request.
svg.text: Did they really ask for deletion?
Requests arrive in many languages. Only real deletion requests get audited.
“Please erase my account and all my data.”
“Can you send me a copy of my data?”
Not a deletion? It’s marked “not applicable” and nothing else runs.
